schemaVersion: Ehel Intensive English Course Manifest v1.0
subject: English
audience: Second-language learners of any first language and any age from older children to adults, beginner upwards, studying intensively. Level 1 is written age-neutral: no child-only worlds and no adult-only worlds.

cefr.name: Common European Framework of Reference for Languages
cefr.role: Defines what a learner can DO at the end of each level, and therefore what each level's exit assessment tests. This is the framework the course reports against.
cefr.structure: Level 1 (Stages 1-3) runs Pre-A1 to A1 and Level 2 (Stages 4-6) A1 to A2, following the owner's planning note of 2026-09-11. Level 2 is still the earlier B1 course until it is rebuilt on the same model.

cambridge.name: Cambridge Primary English as a Second Language 0057; Cambridge Primary English 0058; Cambridge Lower Secondary English 0861
cambridge.role: 0057 is the CONTRACT for Levels 1 and 2: every 0057 objective of a level's stages is placed in exactly one unit (plan field `esl`), and the build fails a unit whose outcomes do not cite its placed objectives. 0058 is an optional literacy cross-reference. Level 2 until it is rebuilt, and Level 3 and above, keep the 0058 / 0861 codes of the school units they were compressed from.

frameworks.howTheyRelate: They are not the same axis. A Cambridge stage supplies the language sequence; CEFR sets the target and is recorded separately for each skill as a language-support measure. Level 1 follows the owner's planning note (Stages 1-3, Pre-A1 to A1) and Level 2 will follow Stages 4-6 (A1 to A2). Completing a level does not by itself establish a CEFR level: reading, writing, listening and speaking are assessed separately and may be at different levels.

level.label: Level 2 — Independence

cefrBands.canDo: Cope with routine situations, follow the main points of clear standard input, and produce simple connected text.
Sustain an argument, report what others said, and write formally for a real purpose — the bridge into B2.

level.exitDescriptor: Exits at a secure B1 reaching towards B2. The learner becomes an independent user: can follow the main points of clear standard input, take part in extended discussion on familiar and unfamiliar topics, read and judge a source, report what other people said, write formally for a real purpose, and argue a position with support.
level.exitAssessment: B1 exit test across the four skills. This is the level that matters commercially — it is where a learner becomes an independent user and qualifies for foundation and pathway steps.
